update.title: Search for 'Two vectors are orthogonal' in ch1-vectors.typ

terminal_output_delta.data:
26-== Inner products
27-
28-The standard inner product on $RR^n$ is $chevron.l bold(u), bold(v) chevron.r = sum_(i=1)^n u_i v_i$.
29:Two vectors are orthogonal when their inner product is zero.
30-The length $norm(bold(v))$ of a vector is given by $norm(bold(v))^2 = chevron.l bold(v), bold(v) chevron.r$, and the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality bounds any inner product by the lengths:
31-
32-$ |chevron.l bold(u), bold(v) chevron.r| <= norm(bold(u)) norm(bold(v)). $ <eq-cauchy-schwarz>
